title: Ataraxia landing page white background instead of dark web3 UI
problem: Tailwind CSS v4 not compiling because @tailwindcss/vite plugin was missing from vite.config.js, causing @theme and @tailwind utilities to not generate CSS variables like --color-bg:#0a0a0f
solution: 1. Install @tailwindcss/vite: `npm install --save-dev @tailwindcss/vite`. 2. Update vite.config.js to import and use the plugin: `import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'` + `plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()]`. 3. Add critical inline CSS in index.html for immediate dark background: `<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark"/><meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a0f"/><style>:root{color-scheme:dark} html{background:#0a0a0f} html,body{background-color:#0a0a0f!important;color:#f0f0f5} #root{min-height:100vh;background:#0a0a0f}</style>`. 4. Build and deploy: `npm run build` + `rsync dist/ -> /var/www/ataraxia/` + `nginx reload`
